Attack against burning enemies +6%, then +4%/Lv (+38% at Lv9). Also works on bosses. Can inflict burn on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

Every second, burn may spread from a burning enemy to a nearby enemy (15% at Lv1, +3 pp per additional Lv). Wind blades hitting burning enemies also spread fire to nearby enemies. Can inflict burn on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

Applying 4 burn stacks to a burning enemy triggers an explosion, damaging and burning nearby enemies (the exploding enemy's burn ends). Power and radius increase with Lv. Each enemy can explode once every 4s (6s for bosses). Can inflict burn on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

Slow increases with chill stacks: starting from the 2nd stack, +3.5% slow per stack (+7.5% at Lv9), up to 3 additional stacks. Chill duration +0.15s/Lv. Can inflict chill on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

This card alone lets you hold 1 Shield. Freezing an enemy or applying 3 chill stacks restores 1 Shield (once every 19s at Lv1, reduced by 1s per additional Lv). Can inflict chill on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

Hitting a frozen enemy or one with 3+ chill stacks triggers a shatter follow-up (half damage to nearby enemies). Freeze and chill stacks are removed. Bosses can also be shattered under the same conditions, building up BREAK (once every 8s per boss). Power and BREAK increase with Lv. Can inflict chill on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

Lightning strikes charge enemies for 2s. Attack against charged enemies +6%, then +4%/Lv. Lightning damage against chilled or frozen enemies +8%, then +4%/Lv, with easier chaining to them. Can trigger lightning by itself: 5% chance at Lv1, +1 pp per additional Lv.

Every 3 hits from a single attack trigger an extra lightning strike (up to 3). Works well with multi-hit and area attacks. Extra strikes deal 65% of normal lightning damage, then +5 pp per additional Lv. Can trigger lightning by itself: 5% chance at Lv1, +1 pp per additional Lv.

Lightning strikes build charge. When full, the next strike becomes a Judgment Bolt, damaging nearby enemies, briefly stunning regular enemies, and building up BREAK on bosses. Requires 10 strikes at Lv1 (6 at Lv9); power ×2.2 at Lv1 (×3.8 at Lv9). At most once every 4s. Can trigger lightning by itself: 5% chance at Lv1, +1 pp per additional Lv.

Wind blades grow stronger and trigger more often as you run faster (scaling from 40km/h to a maximum at 120km/h). At maximum speed, +14% power and +1.5 pp trigger chance, then +4% power and +0.5 pp chance per additional Lv. Can release wind blades by itself: 6% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

Attack against airborne enemies (launched or flying) +6%, then +4%/Lv. Hitting them while airborne yourself triggers a wind follow-up (power 7.5, then +1.5/Lv). Can release wind blades by itself: 6% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

Wind blades fire in succession: 2 at Lv1–6, 3 at Lv7–9. Follow-up blades deal 30% of normal damage, then +3 pp per additional Lv. Can release wind blades by itself: 6% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv. Follow-up volleys trigger at most once per second and deal half damage to bosses.
